providers.keyHint: Starts with sk-; create one on OpenAI's API keys page.
providers.corsEvidence: OPTIONS /chat/completions from https://coffee-test.vercel.app on 2026-11-17: HTTP 200, access-control-allow-origin echoes the origin, access-control-allow-headers authorization,content-type. GET /models preflight: HTTP 200, allow-origin *.

listModels.note: Needs the key (401 without). Lists every model on the account, including embedding, audio and image models, so filter by id.

models.label: GPT-6 Luna
models.why: A good everyday pick: quick, reads your photos, and the cheapest here.
models.devNote: OpenAI calls it its most efficient model for focused, high-volume tasks. Reasoning model with image input, and the cheapest current GPT-6.

models.label: GPT-6.1 Terra
models.why: A mid-priced step up for long reviews across many brews.
models.devNote: Middle tier, for long multi-brew trend reviews when Luna's advice is too thin.

models.label: GPT-6.2 Sol
models.why: The most capable and the priciest here, for the hardest dial-in questions.
models.devNote: OpenAI's pick for balancing intelligence and cost. Use it for the hardest dial-in questions.

providers.notes: Prices: Standard tier, prompts up to 272K tokens, from https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing; models and image input from https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models ('All latest OpenAI models support text and image input'). These are reasoning models: send max_completion_tokens instead of max_tokens (OpenAI's Chat Completions reference says max_tokens 'is now deprecated in favor of max_completion_tokens, and is not compatible with o-series models', and that parameter support differs 'particularly for newer reasoning models'; https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/chat/subresources/completions/methods/create), and leave temperature unset (OpenRouter's supported_parameters for openai/gpt-6-luna on 2026-11-17 list max_completion_tokens and reasoning_effort but not temperature). response_format json_schema (Structured Outputs) is supported. Images go in user content as {type:'image_url', image_url:{url:'data:image/jpeg;base64,...'}}. OpenAI's model pages document new models through the Responses API; Chat Completions still answers. Key prefix: sk-, and sk-proj- for project keys.

providers.name: Anthropic (Claude)
providers.keyHint: Starts with sk-ant-; API use is billed separately from a Claude.ai subscription.
providers.corsEvidence: OPTIONS /messages from https://coffee-test.vercel.app requesting x-api-key,anthropic-version,anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access,content-type on 2026-11-17: HTTP 200, access-control-allow-origin *. The same preflight without anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access fails: HTTP 400 'Disallowed CORS origin' with no allow-origin header (seen on /chat/completions, and re-checked on /messages on 2026-11-17: HTTP 400, 22-byte body, no allow-origin). A key-less POST /messages carrying the header answered 401 with access-control-allow-origin *; without the header the 401 had no allow-origin. So the browser header is mandatory. GET /models preflight with the header: HTTP 200, allow-origin *.

listModels.note: Send the same x-api-key, anthropic-version and browser header as chat. Returns data[] with id, display_name, max_input_tokens, max_tokens and capabilities.

models.label: Claude Haiku 5.5
models.why: A good everyday pick: quick, reads your photos, and the cheapest Claude.
models.devNote: Cheapest current Claude, with vision and a 1M context. Price rises to $0.50/$2.50 for prompts over 100K tokens. Adaptive thinking is on (default effort medium); send output_config.effort 'low' to keep analyses cheap.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.why: A step up for long reviews across many brews, at a much higher price.
models.devNote: Anthropic's 'best combination of speed and intelligence'. Step up for long multi-brew trend reviews.

models.label: Claude Opus 5.5
models.why: The most capable Claude and the priciest; far more than a brew note needs.
models.devNote: Anthropic's default recommendation for most workloads. Far more than a brew note needs; offer it for users who want it.

providers.notes: Native Messages API: POST {baseUrl}/messages with {model, max_tokens (required), system, messages:[{role, content:[{type:'text', text} | {type:'image', source:{type:'base64', media_type:'image/jpeg', data}}]}]}. Answer = content blocks of type 'text' (skip 'thinking' blocks). stop_reason 'max_tokens' means truncated, 'refusal' means declined. On anthropic-version 2026-10-21 the temperature, top_p and top_k parameters are removed and any of them returns HTTP 400, so never send them (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/versioning). JSON output: output_config.format {type:'json_schema', schema}. A personal or service-account key not scoped to a workspace must also send anthropic-workspace-id. Why not Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (https://api.anthropic.com/v1/chat/completions): Anthropic says it is 'primarily intended to test and compare model capabilities' and not production-ready; response_format accepts only json_schema with strict:true (json_object or text returns 400); temperature below 1 returns 400 on Claude 4.7 and later; prompt caching is unsupported (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/cli-sdks-libraries/libraries/openai-sdk; the old /docs/en/api/openai-sdk path still serves it). Prices: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing; models: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview. Browser header background: https://simonwillison.net/2024/Aug/23/anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access/

providers.notes: Uses Perplexity's Orchestrator, an OpenAI Chat Completions-shaped gateway to other labs' models (https://docs.perplexity.ai/api-reference/gateway-chat-completions-post.md): image_url parts are accepted; response_format text, json_object or json_schema (json_schema is always strict); max_tokens is a deprecated alias of max_completion_tokens; unsupported parameters such as seed return 400. Models and tiers from https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/orchestrator/models.md, which does not list per-model image support, so vision flags follow the upstream model. A model above the organisation's tier returns HTTP 402. New organisations start at Tier 0; Tier 1 needs $50 and Tier 2 $250 in lifetime credit purchases (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/admin/rate-limits-usage-tiers.md). Perplexity's own web-search Sonar models answer at https://api.perplexity.ai/chat/completions (CORS also open) with extra search fees; Perplexity now points Sonar users to its Agent API.

listModels.note: Not guaranteed. Most OpenAI-compatible servers answer GET /models, but if it fails let the user type a model id.

providers.notes: Any service that speaks POST {baseUrl}/chat/completions in the OpenAI format, for example a company gateway or a self-hosted server. Prices are unknown, so show token counts without a cost. The key is sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' to the address the user enters, and nowhere else.
